_note: Stars Without Number Revised psionics: the mechanics this engine implements, re-expressed. SWN has no verified SRD licence, so no power names, tables or prose from the book are reproduced here - only the resource arithmetic the rules require (Effort, Commitment durations, Torching, and the restricted/unrestricted package distinction). See docs/licenses/ISSUE_569_WITHOUT_NUMBER_RIGHTS.md.

sources.psionics: Stars Without Number Revised (2017), Psionics pp.29-31 (printed): Psionic Skills, Effort and Psychic Abilities, Torching

swn_partial_psychic.note: may master one discipline and may not raise another

progression._note: Each improvement of a discipline's skill level buys exactly one new technique from that discipline, chosen immediately; the core technique comes free at rank 0 and improves with the skill. No pick may be banked.
